title: LA 100 Plan Projected Ratepayer Impacts / Public Outrage / Rising Electric Bills / Implementation Timelines / Customer Impact
motion: I FURTHER MOVE that LADWP be REQUESTED to provide a comparative analysis between the City's LA100 plan and the requirements of California Senate Bill 100 (SB100), including: A summary of the key policy differences between LA100 and SB100. Identification of any requirements, timelines, mandates, or implementation strategies contained within LA100 that exceed or accelerate the requirements of SB100. An estimate of the additional costs associated with implementation of LA100 beyond those required to comply with SB100 alone. A comparative analysis of projected ratepayer impacts under: implementation of LA100 Full Compliance with SB100 without additional LA100 requirements An assessment of whether implementation of SB100 alone would materially reduce projected electric rate increases for LADWP customers. Recommendations for balancing environmental goals with affordability and ratepayer protections for residents and businesses of the City of Los Angeles. PRESENTED BY JOHN USb8. LEE Councilmember, 12th District GINAL SECONDED Adr. adgin
